result.summary: Found a few minor layout and styling inconsistencies on the page, primarily in the 'Fastest near you' section.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' section, the restaurant card images have varying heights, which causes the restaurant names below them to be vertically misaligned.
issues.suggestion: Set a fixed height or uniform aspect ratio for the image containers and use 'object-fit: cover' to ensure all images and subsequent text align consistently.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icon on the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card is a plain white icon, while the heart icon on the pizza card below it has a dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the styling of the favorite icons across all cards to maintain visual consistency.

issues.description: The search icon in the bottom navigation bar appears malformed, with a flat top edge instead of a smooth circle.
issues.suggestion: Replace the icon with a properly rendered search icon asset.
